substitutionResilience.basis: Custom-engineered mission-critical electrical systems and project qualification create meaningful replacement friction, though alternatives exist.

supplyChainResilience.basis: Strong liquidity and capacity investment support resilience, but manufacturing throughput and project components remain successor bottlenecks.
